hooks.name: a11y-check
hooks.description: Reviews saved UI components and styles for accessibility problems.

action.prompt: Review the UI file that was just saved for accessibility. Check: every form control has a label; interactive elements are real buttons or links and work with the keyboard; focus is visible; live updates (narration, status) use aria-live or role=status; color is not the only signal (pass/fail also has text or an icon); text contrast meets WCAG AA in both light and dark themes; animation respects prefers-reduced-motion. Fix clear problems directly and list anything that needs a decision.
